desc: Jergosh's Topknot: Jergosh the Invoker's look from World of Warcraft Classic (an orc warlock): a tall tuft of dark purple hair tied up in a topknot on top of the head with a gold band - his hairdo worn as the piece. It sits on the head above the brow; the face stays fully visible

Jergosh's Robes: Jergosh the Invoker's look from World of Warcraft Classic: a long dark brown-maroon warlock robe with thin red trim lines down the front, HUGE rounded lavender-purple shoulder pads, wide red-orange banded bracers and a red-orange sash

Taragaman's Spikes: Taragaman the Hungerer's look from World of Warcraft (a felguard demon): a crest of tall, sharp, dark-red horn spikes rising up and back from the top and back of the head like a felguard's, set in a red-and-gold armoured skullcap with a pointed gold brow piece. It sits on the head above the brow; the ogre's own face stays fully visible
name: Taragaman's Spikes

desc: Taragaman's Fel Armour: Taragaman the Hungerer's look from World of Warcraft (a felguard demon): a BARE chest, with felguard armour in deep red with gold trim: one huge spiked red-and-gold pauldron on one shoulder, heavy spiked red gauntlets on the forearms, a gold-trimmed red plate belt with a pointed gold piece at the front, and red armoured plates on the hips. Deep blood red and gold, sharp spiky edges
name: Taragaman's Fel Armour

desc: Anacondra's Circlet: Lady Anacondra's look from World of Warcraft (a night elf Druid of the Fang): long silvery-white hair swept back over the head (a headpiece) with a thin gold circlet and a small coiled gold serpent at the brow. It sits on the head above the brow; the face stays fully visible
name: Anacondra's Circlet

desc: Anacondra's Vestments: Lady Anacondra's look from World of Warcraft: a sleeveless, fitted PURPLE leather druid outfit covered in flowing gold serpent-like swirl patterns, with gold arm bands; purple and gold only, NO green
name: Anacondra's Vestments

desc: Serpentis's Mohawk: Lord Serpentis's look from World of Warcraft (a troll Druid of the Fang): a tall, spiky TEAL troll mohawk swept up and back, on a purple leather headband. It sits on the head above the brow; the face stays fully visible
name: Serpentis's Mohawk

desc: Serpentis's Fang Leathers: Lord Serpentis's look from World of Warcraft: purple druid leathers with bright green and orange striped trims and sleeves, a gold serpent belt buckle and a gold-trimmed shoulder piece
name: Serpentis's Fang Leathers

desc: Rhahk'Zor's Horn: Rhahk'Zor's look from World of Warcraft (the ogre foreman of the Deadmines): a single thick, pale, cone-shaped horn spike sticking straight up from the top of the head, on a worn leather strap. It sits on the head above the brow; the face stays fully visible
name: Rhahk'Zor's Horn

desc: Rhahk'Zor's Loincloth: Rhahk'Zor's look from World of Warcraft (the ogre foreman of the Deadmines, as in WoW Classic): a bare chest and belly, a red loincloth with a dark belt, wide red-and-white striped cloth bands round the wrists and upper arms, and red tribal paint stripes on the shoulders
name: Rhahk'Zor's Loincloth

desc: Mr. Smite's Horns: Mr. Smite's look from World of Warcraft (the tauren first mate of the Defias): two big, wide tauren horns curving out to the sides and up, pale grey-white, rising from a thick shaggy mane of long BLACK hair swept back over the top of the head and hanging down the back. Like a headpiece: horns and mane sit on the head above the brow; the ogre's own face stays fully visible

Mr. Smite's Harness: Mr. Smite's look from World of Warcraft (the tauren first mate of the Defias): a shaggy charcoal-black fur vest, a black leather harness of straps crossing the chest with a big square GOLD BUCKLE in the middle of the chest, wide purple bracers with gold bands on the forearms, a black belt, and dark charcoal-grey trousers with pale stitching. All dark greys and black with gold and purple accents; NO red, no coat

Springvale's Hair: Commander Springvale's look from World of Warcraft Classic (a human paladin): long ginger-red hair swept back off the face down to the shoulders - his hairdo worn as the piece. The face stays fully visible

Springvale's Plate: Commander Springvale's look from World of Warcraft Classic: polished silver-white plate armour with blue trim lines, rounded silver shoulder pads edged in blue, and plated gauntlets with blue bands

Silverlaine's Grey Hair: Baron Silverlaine's look from World of Warcraft Classic (an old human nobleman): neat grey hair combed back at the sides and the back of the head, thin on top - his hairdo worn as the piece. The face stays fully visible

Silverlaine's Finery: Baron Silverlaine's look from World of Warcraft Classic: a white shirt with full puffy sleeves and an ornate buttoned front, a short rust-red vest with silver and maroon trim, a purple-and-silver chained belt, green trousers with gold piping and purple trim at the knees. No ghostly blue, no cape

Sarevess's Fin Crest: Lady Sarevess's look from World of Warcraft (a naga sea witch): a huge fan-shaped crest of spiky VIOLET-PURPLE fins rising up and out behind the head. It sits on the head above the brow; the face stays fully visible
name: Sarevess's Fin Crest

desc: Sarevess's Scales: Lady Sarevess's look from World of Warcraft: a naga bodice of GOLDEN-orange scales banded like a snake's belly, with spiky violet-purple fin frills at the shoulders and hips
name: Sarevess's Scales

desc: Kelris's Beard: Twilight Lord Kelris's look from World of Warcraft Classic (an orc): a long dark purple braided beard hanging down onto the chest, tied with gold rings, covering the chin and mouth (and the tusks); the eyes stay uncovered

Kelris's Twilight Robes: Twilight Lord Kelris's look from World of Warcraft Classic: a long dark maroon-black robe with thin pink trim, HUGE ornate lavender-purple shoulder pads with swirling teal filigree, magenta-pink banded bracers, and a glowing blue collar at the neck

Deepfury's Beard: Kam Deepfury's look from World of Warcraft: a big braided coal-black dwarf beard with iron beard rings, worn with a dark iron skullcap; it hangs from the chin but the mouth stays visible

Deepfury's Armour: Kam Deepfury's look from World of Warcraft (a Dark Iron dwarf): dark blue-black iron armour with grey fur trims at the shoulders, a wide studded black belt, banded bracers with fur cuffs, and a round iron-rimmed shield strapped on the back
name: Deepfury's Armour

desc: Hamhock's Other Head: Hamhock's look from World of Warcraft (a TWO-HEADED ogre): a funny stuffed second ogre head strapped on top of the head like a hat, with its own small spiked topknot, little tusks and a grumpy face, the same skin colour as the wearer. It sits on top, above the brow; the wearer's face stays fully visible
name: Hamhock's Other Head

desc: Hamhock's Loincloth: Hamhock's look from World of Warcraft: a bare chest and belly with blue tribal tattoo bands on the shoulders and arms, a blue loincloth with white trim, and wide blue-and-gold banded wristbands
name: Hamhock's Loincloth

desc: Electrocutioner Cockpit: Electrocutioner 6000's look from World of Warcraft (a gnomish spider mech): a dark purple-grey steel cockpit helm with a domed top, two bright headlamps at the front and little crackling electric prongs. It sits on the head above the brow; the face stays fully visible
name: Electrocutioner Cockpit

desc: Electrocutioner Frame: Electrocutioner 6000's look from World of Warcraft: dark purple-grey steel mech armour with rivets and pipes, and long jointed spider-like metal legs bending out from behind the shoulders, little sparks of electricity crackling between them
name: Electrocutioner Frame

desc: Pummeler Dome: Crowd Pummeler 9-60's look from World of Warcraft (a gnomish arena robot): a round glass cockpit dome helmet with a chrome rim and a glowing yellow lamp on top, framed by shiny ORANGE-RED armour plates. It sits on the head above the brow; the face stays fully visible through or below it
name: Pummeler Dome

desc: Pummeler Plating: Crowd Pummeler 9-60's look from World of Warcraft: big, shiny ORANGE-RED robot armour plates with chrome-silver joints and rivets, huge rounded orange shoulder plates, a chrome grille on the chest and striped chrome pistons on the arms
name: Pummeler Plating

desc: Aggem's Quill Mane: Aggem Thorncurse's look from World of Warcraft Classic (a quilboar shaman): a huge spiky crest of long grey-white and brown quills fanning up and out like a quilboar's mane, with two curved pale boar tusks at the sides. It sits on the head above the brow; the face stays fully visible
name: Aggem's Quill Mane

desc: Aggem's Shaman Hides: Aggem Thorncurse's look from World of Warcraft Classic: a shaggy grey-white hide shawl over the shoulders, maroon-red spiked leather bracers, and a maroon-red cloth wrap round the hips tied with a thick yellow rope belt
name: Aggem's Thorn Wraps

desc: Ramtusk's War Helm: Overlord Ramtusk's look from World of Warcraft Classic (a quilboar warlord): a red-brown iron war helm with a tall spike on top tied with an orange rope tuft and pink quills poking out round it, open-faced: the face stays fully visible

Ramtusk's Spiked Plate: Overlord Ramtusk's look from World of Warcraft Classic: heavy red-brown plate armour with huge boxy shoulder pads studded with big steel spikes, and red scale mail over the chest and arms

Saltspine's Hat: Saltspine's look from World of Warcraft (a giant crocolisk of the Excavation Site): the same homemade patchwork-quilt crocolisk hat, recoloured in sandy golden-tan and ochre fabric squares with darker brown ridges and little white salt-crust flecks along the top, a long jaw full of white teeth and two bulging eyes. It sits on the head above the brow; the face stays fully visible

Saltspine's Onesie: Saltspine's look from World of Warcraft: the same homemade patchwork-quilt crocolisk onesie, recoloured in sandy golden-tan and ochre fabric squares with darker brown bumpy ridges, little white salt-crust flecks on the back and shoulders, a pale ridged belly panel and a long thick stuffed tail. A loose, roomy costume

Shadetooth's Hat: Shadetooth's look from World of Warcraft (a fierce raptor of the Excavation Site): the same homemade painted-cardboard raptor hat, repainted with poster paint in orange-pink with magenta-purple stripes and a few teal touches, and ONE new detail: a curved cardboard horn sticking up from the tip of the snout. A toothy jaw on top. It sits on the head above the brow; the face stays fully visible

Shadetooth's Onesie: Shadetooth's look from World of Warcraft: the same homemade painted-cardboard raptor onesie, repainted with poster paint in orange-pink with magenta-purple stripes, a cream belly, and a string of chunky teal-painted cardboard beads round the neck. A loose, roomy costume
